note: Headings such as France. Armée--History--Indochinese War, 1946-1954 are free-floating combinations because --History may be further subdivided by wars or armed conflicts in which the military service took part; no proposal is needed.
Headings of the type [first language]--Dictionaries--[second language], e.g. Spanish language--Dictionaries--Cakchikel, are free-floating and need no proposal.

LC reconfirmed that comic books or strips about a topic are expressed by the free-floating [topic]--Comic books, strips, etc.; new topical form headings such as Adventure comic books, strips, etc. are not established, UFs of the form [literary form]--Comic books, strips, etc. are inappropriate, and the subdivision is not used under form headings for fictional genres. Earlier approved headings like War comic books, strips, etc. will be cancelled.
College orations is not made May Subd Geog; the long-standing practice of subdividing it by college or university is retained.
Goddesses, Polynesian cannot be geographically subdivided because Polynesia is a region larger than a country, following the pattern of Goddesses of the Caribbean and Central Asia.
LC will not begin a pattern of class-of-persons headings for persons with a negative disease status, such as HIV-negative gay men or HIV-negative women.
Added to the H 1180 plants and crops list: --Seeds--Production (Biology).

Headings for individual anatomical features of particular animals (e.g. Insect wings--Aerodynamics) are not established unless the feature exists on only one animal type; use the feature heading post-coordinated with [animal]--Anatomy, e.g. Wings (Anatomy) and Insects--Anatomy.

Headings for virtual worlds or the characters living in them are qualified by Virtual reality, e.g. Paulovia (Virtual reality), with the BT Virtual reality; classes of virtual entities (Virtual pets) may be established without the qualifier.
Persian poetry--Pushto authors was not needed because --Pushto authors was also proposed under English literature, the pattern heading for literatures.
The subdivision --Reporting is not established under individual crimes (as decided on Weekly List 48 of 2010); a separate heading Crime reporting by victims could be proposed instead.
--Statues is free-floating under names of individual persons; a statue of a person needs no proposal.
Added to the H 1200 wars list: --Forest warfare (May Subd Geog).
Added to the H 1147 animals list: --Larvae--Effect of water pollution on (May Subd Geog) and --Larvae--Effect of water quality on (May Subd Geog).
Added to the H 1195 land vehicles list: --Motors (Diesel)--Turbochargers (May Subd Geog).
--Statues is free-floating under names of persons, so a heading for an individual person's statue is not established.
--Maori authors is free-floating under literatures, so New Zealand literature--Maori authors needed no proposal.
Traffic congestion--Reduction was not approved because the heading Traffic congestion already covers both the congested condition and its relief or reduction.
LCSH does not differentiate the original land area of a park or reserve from later additions; the heading for the park itself is applied instead of a subdivision such as --Addition.

--Population free-floats under places and ethnic groups and is specifically established under Prehistoric peoples and Minorities, but is not extended to specific minorities; use the minority heading subdivided by place and --Statistics.
Added to the H 1149 chemicals list: --Dissolution (May Subd Geog).
Added to the H 1158 materials list: --Dissolution (May Subd Geog).
--Charters was not made free-floating under types of corporate bodies; charters are established as phrase headings (Municipal charters, County charters, Bank charters).
Portuguese language--Orthography and spelling--Problems, exercises, etc. is a free-floating combination: H 1154 permits the first subdivision and H 1095 the second.
--Constitutions was not made free-floating under types of corporate bodies; phrase headings for constitutions of individual types may be proposed case by case.
--Law and legislation is not used under headings for individual crimes (stated on Tentative List 01 of 2011).

South Sudan--History--Civil War, 1955-1972 and 1983-2005 were refused because the existing Sudan--History--Civil War headings cover the pre-split jurisdiction; only wars established under United States--History may also be established as events under a locality, and other wars are post-coordinated with the subordinate jurisdiction.
Isolated islands or island groups comprising more than one autonomous jurisdiction are not qualified, so Lesser Sunda Islands is not given a qualifier.
Geographic features in the United States are differentiated by qualifier only to the county level, so two Lookout Mountains in the same county share one heading.
Added to the H 1159 military services list: --Non-commissioned officers.
LCSH has no pattern of [topic] in adoption headings; Discrimination in adoption was refused and the headings Discrimination and Adoption are post-coordinated.
For the tomb of an individual named for that individual, the free-floating [name of person]--Tomb is assigned rather than a separate heading.
European letters--Renaissance, 1450-1600--History and criticism is a free-floating combination under H 1156.

LC will not begin a pattern of headings for each prejudice affecting specific groups in the military (e.g. Homophobia in the military--Law and legislation); assign [group]--Civil rights or [group]--Legal status, laws, etc. instead.
The inverted qualifier used with Arts must be a nationality or ethnic group, not a language group such as Finno-Ugric; Arts--[place] could be used instead.
--Treaties is used under ethnic groups and individual wars, not under topical headings; topical headings and Treaties are post-coordinated.
LCSH does not include geographic region headings for the countries comprising regional organizations.
Geographic features in the United States are differentiated only to the county level; multiple same-named features of the same type in one county get one undifferentiated heading with a 667 note.
Added to the H 1105 corporate bodies list: form subdivision --Blogs.
Added to the H 1147 animals list: --Embryos--Effect of water quality on and --Larvae--Effect of water quality on.
--Conservation and restoration free-floats under types of library materials.
Popular music--Puerto Rico--2011-2020 uses free-floating subdivisions under H 1916.5; no proposal needed.

--Religious aspects was not made free-floating under all non-religious topics because it is hard to tell which headings are inherently religious; H 1998 explains when it is free-floating and when it must be proposed under a specific heading.
Headings combining an ethnic group with HIV-positive persons (e.g. Hispanic American HIV-positive persons) set an undesirable precedent; the existing headings of that form will be cancelled.
The study of a geographic area is expressed as [place]--Study and teaching; -ology headings such as Egyptology are exceptions, not precedents.

Because Architecture may be geographically subdivided and Architecture--Western influences exists, each Architecture--[place]--Western influences string need not be established; see H 870 for interposing geographic subdivisions.
France. Armée--History and its war subdivisions are free-floating combinations.
Hungarian drama--21st century and --History and criticism are free-floating combinations under H 1156.
LCSH has no pattern of Intimate partners of [group] headings; existing headings like Couples or Spouses are post-coordinated with the group.
Film festival programming is expressed by the free-floating construction Film festivals--Planning.
Metropolitan area headings are constructed free-floating by inserting Metropolitan Area between the city name and its geographic qualifier.
Regions with directional qualifiers are established only if well-defined and generally recognized in English-language reference sources; further authoritative citations are required.
The chronological subdivision --21st century is free-floating under Art, Hungarian.

Nationality headings cannot be used without a geographic subdivision; [nationality]--Foreign countries is assigned only for people of a nationality in several foreign countries, and is not made a UF of the bare nationality heading.
Because Decoration and ornament may be geographically subdivided, Decoration and ornament--Russia (Federation) is assigned instead of Decoration and ornament, Russian.
Malian Mandingo literature is expressed as Epic poetry, Mandingo--Mali, Mandingo literature--Mali, and Mandingo poetry--Mali, not as headings qualified Malian (Mandingo).
It is not necessary to propose geographic subdivisions; Folk songs, Serbian--Montenegro needs no proposal.
--Decision making is free-floating under topical headings for works on the process of arriving at decisions for action.
Presidents may be subdivided geographically, so Presidents--Egypt--Election needed no proposal.
Congo (Democratic Republic)--History--Civil War, 1998- was refused because Congo (Democratic Republic)--History--1997- already covers the period; a UF for the war was added instead.

Cooking headings use a generally recognizable taxonomic group, intermediate grouping, or common name (Cooking (Orchids), Cooking (Smelts), Cooking (Shad)) rather than an obscure species name; H 1475 will be revised.
Fable writers is geographically subdividable, so Fable writers--Kyrgyzstan is used rather than Fable writers, Kyrgyz.
Except for American ethnic groups, nationalities in foreign countries are expressed as nationality plus place (Koreans--China), not composite names like Korean Chinese.
Music--Thematic catalogs--Bibliography and --Code words are free-floating combinations.
--Law and legislation is free-floating under individual diseases and types of diseases.

LC will not continue establishing headings for specific relationships (Prostitute-client relationships); the free-floating --Professional relationships under classes of persons is used, e.g. Prostitutes--Professional relationships.
A tomb of an individual named for that individual takes the free-floating [name of person]--Tomb.
Added to the H 1156 literatures list: --Finnish authors, --Hungarian authors, --Icelandic authors, --Slovak authors.
Added to the H 1161 musical instruments list: form subdivisions --Methods (Barrelhouse) and --Methods (Rockabilly), each also with --Group instruction and --Self-instruction.

Nationalities outside the United States are expressed by nationality headings subdivided by place (Germans--Canada), extended to ethnic groups; Arab Canadians is not valid, so use Arabs--Canada with Business enterprises--Canada.

Group-of-authors headings such as Bulimia patients' writings, Irish (English) are assigned only to literary collections by two or more authors; a single-author memoir gets a subject heading such as Bulimia--Patients--Biography.
--Effect of music on is free-floating under individual animals and groups of animals.
--Prevention free-floats under situations to be avoided, such as poverty.
There is no precedent for qualifying a crime by the class of persons who commit it (Sex crimes by teenagers); the class-of-persons heading Teenage sex offenders is used.

LCSH treats Arabic literature specially: headings like Algerian literature or Short stories, Algerian are not created; Arabic literature, short stories, etc. are subdivided geographically (Short stories, Arabic--Algeria), with a UF from [nationality] literature.
Medium-of-performance headings such as Trios (Guitar, oud, violin) may be constructed under H 1917.5 without an authority record.
Added to the H 1156 literatures list: --Czech authors and --Czechoslovak authors.
Ethnic groups living in a non-US country are expressed as group plus place (Asians--New Zealand), not as a composite name such as Asian New Zealanders.

The qualifier in headings for carols is language-based, so Carols, Flemish becomes Carols, Dutch; before 1830 Dutch is the language used for Belgian literature and manuscripts (Manuscripts, Dutch rather than Flemish).
The qualifier in headings for folk songs is a language, not a nationality; Folk songs, Montenegrin was refused.

patterns: English horn and oboe with orchestra
note: The authority record for English horn and oboe music authorizes the phrase as a medium of performance in other headings without further proposals.
Serbia and Montenegro--Literatures remains valid for the pre-split geographic coverage, like Yugoslavia--Literatures and Czechoslovakia--Literatures.
Added to the H 1150 diseases list: --Early detection (May Subd Geog).

Style subdivisions under Cooking, Canadian require evidence of a stylistically distinct cuisine, not just local ingredients; Cooking, Canadian--Maritime Provinces style already covers New Brunswick, Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island.
Individual works of fiction may not be assigned form headings; under the special fiction access provisions an LCSH form heading may be used only if GSAFD has none and it must be unqualified.
Exterritoriality has no connotation of place and is not geographically subdivided; China--Law is post-coordinated with it.
There is no precedent for [class of persons]--Violence against--Law and legislation; assign Gays--Violence against, Gays--Legal status, laws, etc., and Homophobia--Law and legislation separately.
--Law and legislation is unnecessary under Hacktivism because it is in the Computer crimes hierarchy and is inherently legal.
The multiple subdivision Hell--Buddhism, [Christianity, etc.] already permits Hell--Islam.
Latin America--Social conditions--1830- needs evidence that 1830 is a significant date and enough material (bibliographic file maintenance) to warrant a new time period.
Added to the H 1147 animals list: --Embryos--Effect of temperature on (May Subd Geog).
--Video games is not established as a form subdivision for now, pending an OLAC review of the video game headings.

Authors writing in English in their own country are an external author group, so use English literature--Pakistan or English literature--Turkmenistan rather than --Pakistani authors or --Turkmen authors.

Special-year headings are assigned only to general works on the year not limited to specific topics; works on American history and customs of a year get United States--History and --Social life and customs with period subdivisions.
A directional region heading requires a region well-defined and generally recognized by that name in English-language reference sources; Northeast Asia is not.
Chronological subdivisions under Chinese fiction should follow the dates established under Chinese literature (e.g. --Song dynasty, 960-1279); multiple new dynasty-span headings were refused.
Types of security each have a separate heading for legal aspects in the form [security]--Law and legislation; Internal security--Law and legislation may be proposed.
--Literature and the wars is free-floating under headings for wars via the multiple subdivision --Literature and the war, [revolution, etc.].
A multiple subdivision under Punched card systems was refused; LC is avoiding new multiple subdivisions, and individual headings for specific topics should be proposed.
The term Region may be added free-floating to headings for parks (e.g. Yellowstone National Park Region).

LCSH has no headings of the form [disease]--Etiology--[specific cause] or Drugs--Side effects--[affected function], and LC will not begin the pattern; post-coordinate Diabetes--Etiology with Drugs--Side effects.

New chronological subdivisions under Egypt (e.g. --History--1981-2011) require authority research justifying the date span; the --Politics and government span should not be closed without opening a new one.
LCSH has used --[art form] adaptations only for --Film adaptations and --Television adaptations, which are exceptions; LC will not begin the pattern, so post-coordinate with Ballets.
Maori Americans--Tribal citizenship is a free-floating combination.

--Parodies, imitations, etc. was not extended to literary, music and art genres or to individual characters; LC is avoiding new free-floating subdivisions and new uses of existing ones, and additions to the H 1095-H 1145.5 lists are approved only very conservatively.
Abstract concepts such as Stagnation (Economics) are not geographically subdivided; assign [place]--Economic conditions instead.
Nationality qualifiers (True crime stories, American) refer to the author's nationality; True crime stories--[place] is the less ambiguous way to show where the crime occurred.
H 1095 subdivisions such as --Auditing can follow topical headings and other headings subdivided topically, e.g. United States--Armed Forces--Auditing.
Added to the H 1151 individual educational institutions list: --Lacrosse.

Individual novels may not be assigned form headings; under the special fiction access provisions an LCSH form heading is used only if GSAFD lacks one and must be unqualified by nationality, language or ethnicity.
A chronological subdivision such as --Economic conditions--1276-1313 needs a generally recognized period supported by research and sufficient material, not just one work's subtitle.
LC will not begin establishing subdivisions of the type --Effect of [specific chemical] on; use Fishes--Effect of chemicals on with the chemical heading --Physiological effect.
Scholarships available only to students of one institution are not established as headings; use the free-floating [institution]--Funds and scholarships.
A group must be established before it can be used as a qualifier, so Poets, Shina requires a proposal for the Shina first.

--History and criticism has not been used after [topic]--Comic books, strips, etc. and LC will not begin the practice; LC post-coordinates Comic books, strips, etc.--History and criticism with [topic] in literature and [topic] in art.
Nonspecific form headings are not assigned to collections of fiction by one author.

To add a subdivision to a free-floating list, make two proposals: the [pattern heading]--[subdivision] combination and an SA note on the general heading; only PSD staff create subdivision authority records.
Aleuts--Evacuation and relocation, 1942-1945 needs citations supporting the choice of dates.
Works on children in Bali take Children--Bali, not a Balinese-qualified heading.
LC will not qualify Funeral hymns or Laments by language or nationality; Epicedia is instead authorized for geographic subdivision, like Laments and Dirges.

Specific history ranges under a country (e.g. Law--Greece--Athens--History--To 146 B.C.) are ordinarily established only for aspects like --Social life and customs or --Politics and government, not for topical headings; Constitutional history--Greece--Athens--To 146 B.C. is an exception.
Headings for specific years are assigned only to general works on the time period, not to works limited to a topic.
Zemstvos, local legislative bodies in Russia, are not geographically subdivided; the name heading for the legislature is assigned with the unsubdivided heading.
Added to the H 1100 classes of persons list: --Services for--Law and legislation.
Added to the H 1140 names of places list: --In opera.
Added to the H 1156 literatures list: --Turkmen authors (from Monthly List 11).
[Group]--Persecutions is generally created for groups persecuted at various times in history; for the Albigenses a heading for the crusade is preferred.
Meditations--Religious aspects--Baptists, [Catholic Church, etc.] was refused because the multiple subdivision Meditations--Baptists, [Catholic Church, etc.] already exists.
H 1917.5 allows medium-of-performance headings like this to be constructed without an authority record.
Added to the H 1151 individual educational institutions list: --Softball.

Religious and ethnic law systems are not subdivided by place because the system is the same everywhere; bring out place with a second heading such as Law--India. Islamic law is the unique exception subdivided by place.
A genre heading may be used on an individual work of fiction only if unqualified.
Non-royalty plays denotes legal status, not a genre, so it is not nationality-qualified; assign it unqualified with a qualified genre heading such as American drama.
The LCSH form subdivision --Globes has been cancelled; Globes now covers globes of any celestial sphere.
--Law and legislation is redundant under Cyberbullying because it is in the Crime hierarchy and inherently legal.
Qualified form headings may not be assigned to novels.
There is no precedent for [topic] in fantasy games headings; post-coordinate Monsters with Fantasy games.
Added to the H 1154 languages list: form subdivision --Conversation and phrase books (for beauty operators).
--Modification means physical alteration of tools and does not apply to computer games; modification of games is covered by Computer games--Programming.
Headings for chronological periods are assigned only to general works on the period not limited to specific topics.
News coverage of an unnamed event is expressed with a topical heading, e.g. Student strikes--Press coverage--Québec (Province)--Québec, rather than an event heading with 'in mass media'.
--Participation, [nationality] subdivisions cannot be used under the headings for the world wars; use World War, 1939-1945--Georgia.

No --[...] influences subdivisions exist under Christian civilization and LC will not start the precedent; --Religious identity is established only under Catholics; and --Early church, ca. 30-600 qualifies a preceding subdivision, not the main heading.
--Publishing is free-floating under headings for literature on particular topics, e.g. Philosophical literature--Publishing.
Peace-building in Africa is expressed as Peace-building--Africa, not Peace-building, African.
Added to the H 1147 animals list: --Parasites--Life cycles--Climatic factors.
Added to the H 1158 materials list: --Imaging.
There is no precedent for [topic] film festivals headings (Human rights film festivals, Water film festivals); assign Film festivals plus the topic in motion pictures instead.
LC will not begin category headings like [specific mineral] oxides, fluorides or nitrates; assign the mineral heading with Oxide minerals, Fluoride minerals, etc.
A new period such as Poland--Social life and customs--1980-1989 requires evidence of watershed years, usually forty years or more, and bibliographic file maintenance showing sufficient material.
--21st century is free-floating under major literary genres.

Over 50 phrase headings such as Jerusalem in the Bible were revised to [place]--In the Bible (also --In the Hadith etc.); these subdivisions are not free-floating under places, so each use must be proposed.
A mausoleum without a distinctive name is cataloged under [personal name]--Tomb, e.g. Atatürk, Kemal, 1881-1938--Tomb.
Catalan poetry--21st century is a free-floating combination.
LC declined to add another narrow subdivision to the H 1180 plants and crops list; post-coordinate [plant]--Effect of pesticides on with Herbicide resistance.
Mithila is a region, not a nationality or ethnic group, so use Painting--Mithila (India and Nepal).

Subdivisions on the H 1110 list for personal names are not valid under headings for fictitious and legendary characters or named animals (such subdivisions must be proposed under the specific heading), but the form subdivisions --Comic books, strips, etc., --Drama, --Fiction, --Literary collections and --Poetry remain free-floating there.
Birds--Eggs and Birds--Nests were refused because general SA references already point from Eggs and Nests to the free-floating subdivisions under animals.
Cooking, Canadian--Nunavut style needs evidence of a distinct style, not just local ingredients.
A qualified form heading should not be assigned to an individual novel.
European Union countries is not used as a qualifier (Investments, European) because it conflicts with the authorized free-floating Investments--European Union countries.
News coverage of a topic is expressed as [topic]--Press coverage--[place], e.g. Land reform--Press coverage--Zimbabwe, not as [topic] in mass media.
--Identification is free-floating under classes of persons, so phrase headings like Prisoner identification badges are unnecessary; use Prisoners--Identification.
Qualified form headings should not be assigned to novels.

LCSH does not combine players of an individual sport with an educational level; assign High school athletes and the sport's players separately, and the exceptional High school football players will be cancelled.

Chronological subdivisions of language headings mark major changes in the language itself, not political events; Korean language--History--Japanese occupation, 1910-1945 needs evidence of linguistic watershed years.
Tombs and mausoleums of an individual person are entered under [personal name heading]--Tomb.
Added to the H 1158 materials list: --Radioactive contamination (May Subd Geog); not valid under headings for materials that are inherently radioactive.
The note at Fire prevention instructing use of --Prevention and control under particular types of fires was retained.
--Religious aspects is unnecessary under Mani pills because the topic is inherently religious.
Headings for mythological characters established in the name authority file use the free-floating [mythological character name]--In literature rather than a separate phrase heading.
Schools teaching a dance style are cataloged with [style of dance]--Study and teaching post-coordinated with Dance schools.
Tombs of individual persons or families take the free-floating [name of person]--Tombs or [name of family]--Tombs, e.g. Rucellai family--Tombs.
Antiquities--Climatic factors is ambiguous; post-coordinate [place]--Antiquities with [place]--Climate.
Open-ended chronological subdivisions beginning at the end of the world wars (--Economic conditions--1918-, --1945-) are common LCSH practice and were retained rather than replaced by closed spans.
Added to the H 1147 animals list: --Effect of energy development on.
Headings for individual deities established in the name authority file may take the free-floating --In literature (e.g. Hygieia (Greek deity)--In literature).
Dalmatians may be geographically subdivided, so Dalmatians--New Zealand needed no proposal.
